STAT3 is the target of the CpG-STAT3 drug in Table 1[1], where its target cell reads TLR9 receptor; STAT3[2], and of STAT3 siRNA in Table 2[3], where it reads STAT3[4]. TGF-β1 is the other shared target: it is listed as TGF-β1[5] in Table 2[6], and in Table 1[7] it is part of the STP705 target entry, which reads TGF-β1 COX-[8] continued by 2[9]. KRAS is only a partial match: Table 1[10] lists KRAS (G12D)[11] and KrasG12D[12], while Table 2[13] lists KRAS TGF-β[14], which pairs KRAS with TGF-β rather than naming KRAS alone.
